items.t: Headlights shut off while driving
items.job: Replace HID headlight bulb or ballast
items.note: Price is per side. Toyota's old headlight coverage has ended; ask a dealer about your car's history.

items.t: Head gasket failure
items.job: Replace head gasket and clean EGR system
items.note: Many owners pick a used or rebuilt engine instead. Cost rises a lot if overheating damaged the engine.

items.t: Clogged EGR system
items.job: Clean EGR valve, cooler and intake manifold
items.note: New gaskets are needed. If the EGR cooler or valve must be replaced, parts cost more.

items.t: Inverter overheating and hybrid shutdown
items.job: Replace hybrid inverter assembly
items.note: Often covered by Toyota's inverter recall or extended coverage. Check your VIN. Used inverters cost less.

items.t: Brake booster pump noise or failure
items.job: Replace brake booster pump assembly
items.note: Toyota extended coverage on this part for many cars. Check your VIN with a dealer before paying.

items.t: Electric water pump failure
items.job: Replace electric engine water pump and refill coolant

items.t: Hybrid battery wearing out
items.job: Replace hybrid battery pack
items.note: Rebuilt or remanufactured packs cost less than new. Some cars may still be under hybrid battery warranty.

items.t: Power steering assist can drop out from loose steering nuts (recall)
items.job: Replace steering linkage nuts
items.note: Free under recall 11V-304. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Hybrid system can stall instead of going into limp mode (recall)
items.job: Update hybrid system software
items.note: Free under recall 20V-369. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Engine wire harness can rub through and short (recall)
items.job: Inspect engine wire harness and add protective sleeve
items.note: Free under recall 18V-579. Check the VIN first. Harness is replaced if damaged.

items.t: Parking brake cable can come off its lever (recall)
items.job: Install parking brake cable retaining clips
items.note: Free under recall 16V-741. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger airbag can partly inflate on its own (recall)
items.job: Replace front passenger airbag assembly
items.note: Free under recall 16V-672. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear door can open on its own from a wet door switch (recall)
items.job: Modify rear door opener switch circuits
items.note: Free under recall 26V-049. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Oil in the crankshaft sensor connector can stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace crankshaft position sensor and clean connector
items.note: Free under recall 06V266000. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Power steering warning light with heavy steering (recall)
items.job: Replace electric power steering torque sensor
items.note: Free under recall 00V285000. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering shaft splines can wear and strip (recall)
items.job: Replace steering intermediate shaft
items.note: Free under recall 12V537000. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Hybrid coolant pump wiring can corrode and stop the pump (recall)
items.job: Replace hybrid inverter coolant pump
items.note: Free under recall 12V536000. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Accelerator pedal can be trapped by the floor mat (recall)
items.job: Reshape accelerator pedal and fit correct mat retainers
items.note: Free under recall 09V388000. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering intermediate shaft yoke can crack (recall)
items.job: Replace steering intermediate shaft and sliding yoke
items.note: Free under recall 06V188000. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front air bags may not inflate fully in a crash (recall)
items.job: Replace front air bag inflator modules
items.note: Free under recall 06V096000. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake lights may stop working from a dirty switch (recall)
items.job: Replace brake light switch
items.note: Free under recall 04V558000. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Load capacity label missing or wrong (recalls)
items.job: Supply and fit a corrected load capacity label
items.note: Free under recalls 10V036000 and 10V035000.

items.t: Passenger air bag sensing can read the seat wrongly (recall)
items.job: Recalibrate or replace passenger seat occupant sensing
items.note: Free under recall 13V014000. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Curtain air bag inflator weld can crack (recall)
items.job: Replace curtain air bag inflator
items.note: Free under recall 16V487000. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Windshield cracks from small impacts
items.job: Replace windshield and recalibrate camera if fitted
items.note: Cars with a camera or head-up display behind the glass need recalibration after fitting.

items.t: Spare tire may be under-inflated from the factory (recall)
items.job: Inspect and inflate or replace the temporary spare tire
items.note: Free under recall 17V295000. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Speedometer and gauges can go blank (recall)
items.job: Replace instrument cluster
items.note: Free under recall 19V876000. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake booster pump failure can switch off stability control (recall)
items.job: Replace brake booster pump assembly
items.note: Free under recall 19V544000. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Hybrid system can shut down from a software fault (recall)
items.job: Update hybrid control software
items.note: Free under recall 21V734000. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rearview camera image can freeze or go blank (recall)
items.job: Update multimedia software for the rearview camera
items.note: Free under recall 25V744000. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rodents chew the wiring harness
items.job: Repair rodent-chewed engine wiring harness
items.note: Cost swings with how many circuits were chewed; a full harness section replacement is at the top of the range.
